Live

Makes live and videos brighter and clearer. If your phone feels slow, choose Off.

Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

Add an extra security code step when logging in from a new device. Requires your phone number or email to be verified first (see above).

🚫Off
📱SMS Code
✉️Email Code

Email-code 2FA is enforced at login now. SMS-code 2FA currently also delivers the code by email as an interim step — full SMS delivery is coming soon.

Security PIN

Set a 4-digit PIN to lock your Wallet & Aito Kef section — required each time you open it, even if your phone is unlocked.

App Lock (This Device Only)

A private passphrase — any length, any language — that locks the whole app on this device/browser only. It's separate from your account and from admin access; nobody else's device is affected, and it's not stored on our servers. If you forget it, the only way back in on this device is clearing this site's browser data (your account itself is never lost).

Withdrawals
🔑Require password to withdraw

When on, you must re-enter your password before every withdrawal or Aito Kef purchase request — protects your earnings even if someone else is using your phone while you're logged in.
